_about: Parameters for the Karnataka planning slice (R4-11, checklist Part L). Written on 27 Oct 2026 before any e-4W screening or site result was computed. The all-class district-unit table (claim E21) was already published, so these rules are not pre-registered in the R4-19 sense; the R4-19 freeze (checklist Part I) is still open. Each value states its basis: 'clause' (cited register clause), 'assumption' (team choice, sensitivity not tested) or 'planner_input' (illustrative input, not a proposed or sanctioned amount).

reference_year.note: Latest complete calendar year in S35; same year as claims E20/E21.

served_vehicle_type.note: The only charger configuration with a recorded BEE benchmark cost in S34 Tables 3-4 is CCS-II, a car connector. e-2W and e-3W selection is method only.

unit_screen.metric: served-type BEV registrations in the reference year per BEE candidate site with at least one e-4W confirmed or unknown row (point in the unit)
unit_screen.note: Screening indicator by registering office, not a gap estimate. The minimum avoids ranking units on very small counts.

bee_e4w_compatibility.note: Classified by the connector standard named in S18 charger_type. OSM records use S11 compat_motorcar.

duplication_radius_km.clause: Clause 11(1)(a), page 7 of 36: at least one charging station within a 1 km x 1 km grid in notified urban areas (advisory, 'may be adopted')
duplication_radius_km.note: Used as a distance screen: a candidate is rejected if any e-4W confirmed or unknown charger (BEE or OSM) lies within this radius. This is not the grid-cell compliance metric (checklist I-006 open).

urban_proxy.note: S33 11(1)(a) applies to urban areas notified by the state; no notified list was acquired. Proxy: within this distance of an OSM place=city or place=town node (S23).

selection.objective: largest distance to the nearest e-4W confirmed or unknown charger (coverage gap), ties broken by OSM id
selection.note: Greedy selection in objective order until the public-cost budget is used. No located demand exists inside a unit (RTO data gives the registering office), so the spatial rule uses coverage only.

configuration.clause: Section 7, Tables 3-4 (BEE benchmark costs, Aug 2022): upstream up to 50 kW INR 6.04 lakh; EVSE CCS-II 50 kW INR 7.25 lakh
configuration.note: Benchmark costs, not quotes; no cost range is estimated. Subsidy is a share of the benchmark or actual cost, whichever is lower (S34 section 6).

B.applies_to: PSU OMC outlets (and other government/PSU-controlled locations)

C.applies_to: all other city and highway locations

psu_omc_brands.note: Matched against the OSM brand tag, else operator (lower case). Category B is modelled from the brand only; outlet ownership and nodal-agency eligibility (S34 section 2) are not verified. 'BP' is excluded as ambiguous (Jio-bp is not a PSU).

public_budget_inr_lakh.note: Illustrative budget for one example run. Not a proposed, requested or sanctioned amount.

nearby_radius_km.note: Radius for the listed-charger context on the site card. Listed rated power is not capacity.
